title: Hip Arthroscopy for Femoroacetabular Impingement (FAI) and Labral Tears
description: Medicare coverage criteria for hip arthroscopy to treat femoroacetabular impingement (cam/pincer) and acetabular labral repair. Requires clinical groin pain with positive impingement test (FADIR), alpha angle > 55 degrees or crossover sign, failure of >= 3 months conservative therapy, and absence of advanced osteoarthritis.

criteria.name: Cam/Pincer Impingement on Radiographs (Alpha Angle > 55 deg)
criteria.description: Radiographs or MRI confirming cam morphology with alpha angle > 55 degrees, pincer morphology (crossover sign, center-edge angle > 40), and acetabular labral tear.
criteria.clinical_intent: Radiographic proof of mechanical bony impingement

criteria.name: Conservative Physical Therapy Trial Failure (>= 3 Months)
criteria.description: Documented trial and failure of >= 3 months of conservative management (physical therapy, activity modification, intra-articular injection).

criteria.name: Advanced Hip Osteoarthritis (Tonnis Grade >= 2)
criteria.description: Pre-existing advanced joint space narrowing < 2 mm, subchondral sclerosis, or Tonnis Grade 2 or 3 osteoarthritis.
criteria.clinical_intent: Exclude hip arthroscopy for advanced degenerative joint disease

cms_reference.notes: MCD document at L35456 governs Nerve Blockade, whereas policy subject is Hip Arthroscopy for FAI. Flagged as needing realignment.
